data.one_liner: Dart and Flutter client for the Better Auth platform.
data.what_it_does: Enables secure sign-in, sign-up, social OAuth, and session management in Flutter applications using the Better Auth platform. Supports first-party plugins such as 2FA, passkeys, organizations, and magic links.
use_when: Your backend is built with Better Auth and you need a native Flutter client.
You require secure encrypted session storage and reactive auth state changes in your app.
avoid_when: You use a completely different backend authentication provider like Firebase or Supabase.
strengths: Full-featured integration covering sign-in, sign-up, session management, and first-party plugins.
Built-in reactive auth state with automatic session refresh on app resume and network reconnect.
Encrypted session storage by default using Keychain and Keystore.
weaknesses: Requires a matching Better Auth server setup and configuration.
Native social sign-in requires specific platform-level intent filter configuration.
data.setup_notes: Requires initializing with a base URL and deep-link scheme, and registering the callback activity in Android's AndroidManifest.xml for native social login.

alternatives.name: firebase_auth
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if your backend is Firebase instead of a self-hosted Better Auth server.
